SIM UUIDs come from the server. Each SIM is activated only after you confirm its local slot here. ICCID and IMSI values are never uploaded.
Sent as the SIP destination so the server can map the call to an assistant. Without it the gateway addresses its own extension and the call loops back.
Offering G.711 alongside G.722 usually means the server picks G.711 and every call is narrowband, which is why G.722 alone is the default.

How loud the agent is to the GSM caller. 0 is what the detected device asks for; each step roughly a third louder or quieter. Raise it if callers say the agent is faint, lower it if the line distorts.

com.google.android.material.materialswit.android:text: 开机恢复后台控制同步（SIP 语音需手动启动）

TextView.android:text: Finds the public IP so SIP and RTP survive NAT. Turn off for a SIP server on the local network.
Encrypts SIP signalling — registration, calls and SMS text. Call audio (RTP) is not encrypted either way. The server must offer TLS, usually on port 5061.
SDES-keyed SRTP (RFC 3711). Requires TLS: the keys travel inside the SIP signalling, so over plain UDP they would be readable by anyone on the path.
Rewrites accents before sending: für becomes fuer. Turn on if umlauts arrive mangled. Cyrillic, Hebrew, Arabic and other non-Latin text is never rewritten — it is sent as-is.
